is: Small Svelte components the control specs render: parents that accept a control's changes, a probe that reads the environment, a provider that records every call into the seam, a trigger that records what Tooltip hands it, and a short scrolling box shaped like Storybook's docs page.
conventions: Specs only: the checks tier, never imported by anything that ships. They import the controls and the seam by relative path, as a host would.
A harness that accepts changes keeps its own state and hands it back as the prop, so a spec drives the control the way a real parent does; a refusing parent is written in the spec itself.

`RecordingEnvironment.svelte` provides a frozen environment whose moves and cues call back with the move name, its arguments and the element it attached to; specs use it to prove a control calls the seam. It is one of the seam files with the second-change rule described in `lib/environment`.

fs.name: AcceptingDateField.svelte
fs.role: a parent that accepts every change a DateField reports

fs.name: AcceptingMenu.svelte
fs.role: a parent that accepts every open and close a Menu asks for

fs.name: AcceptingPillSwitch.svelte
fs.role: a parent that accepts every choice a PillSwitch reports

fs.name: AcceptingScrollingTabs.svelte
fs.role: a parent that accepts every tab a ScrollingTabs reports

fs.name: AcceptingSelect.svelte
fs.role: a parent that accepts every value a Select reports

fs.name: AcceptingTabs.svelte
fs.role: a parent that accepts every tab a Tabs reports

fs.name: EnvironmentProbe.svelte
fs.role: reads the environment at a given depth below the provider

fs.name: RecordingEnvironment.svelte
fs.role: provides an environment that records each move attached and each cue played

fs.name: RecordingTrigger.svelte
fs.role: a Tooltip trigger that records the props it is handed and spreads none of them

fs.name: ScrollBoxHost.svelte
fs.role: a short scrolling box around a transformed layer and a light skin scope, so a spec can prove a control scrolls nothing outside itself
